main_text.p: tem, cui regni succeffio in eâ familiâ debebatur, honestissimo prætextu velut ad regnum in patriam revocatum, dissimulatâ voluntate suâ, per eos, qui Agidem necaverant, quasi vindictam ab eo metuentes, interemit, ut solus in sceptro maneret. Nec diu post in Arcadii re feliciter gestâ, animo ad majora audenda erectus, negocio cum vitrico, viro locuplete, & inter cives potentiâ præ-cipuo, Megistono, cui mater firmandi filii ergo denupserat, communicato, & per hunc pluribus sibi cōciliatis, facinus concepit & patravit immane, atque ha-ctenus in civitate Laconicâ inauditum.

Nam ad urbem adducens militares copias priusquàm ipse eam ingrederetur, ephoros in triclinio pro more publicè cænantes, nec quicquam minus opinatos, quos sacrosanctos & inviolabiles civitas habere solet, per præmissos satel-lites inter ipsas epulas trucidavit: eumque magistratum regibus & populo, ut dicebat, gravem, & præter instituta Lycurgi in republicâ receptum, & paulatim ex humili conditione ad potestatem regiâ majorem progressum, è republicâ sustulit. Horum cædi statim addidit cædem decem aliorum, qui succur-rere ephoris conati fuerant. A quiescen-tibus vim abstinuit. Postridiè sellas epho-ab

page.notes: Show-through from the verso (blurred lines "spyqe" and "abfidb" at the foot left, and edge letters at the right edge) is not transcribed. The line "rere ephoris conati fuerant" is displaced and partly overprinted by the adjacent line; its reading is probable but not certain. The left-margin mark "ab" is read as a reference mark and is uncertain. Catchword "epho-" is read with a hyphen, the printed mark is unclear.
